instruction: Search for Marvel toys suitable for children and sort them by price from highest to lowest.

metadata.explanation: Task requires searching for Marvel toys on Kohls.com, filtering for kids category, and sorting by price from high to low. Evaluator verifies breadcrumbs contain 'Marvel', 'Toys', 'Kids' and sort selector shows 'Price High-Low' (S=5 in URL). Uses existing Chrome evaluator framework.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete requirement coverage: Evaluator verifies all instruction requirements - Marvel toys, Kids category, and price sorting from high to low.

Correct getter logic: Uses 'class_multiObject_search_exist' category which calls 'safely_get_text_content()' to extract text from '.pmpSearch_breadcrumb' and '.sbSelector' elements without any hardcoded selector issues.

Dual verification approach: Combines DOM element text extraction (breadcrumbs and sort selector) with URL parameter verification for robustness. URL checks provide redundancy (Marvel/marvel/Toys/Kids in URL, S=5 for price sort).

Correct metric comparison: 'check_direct_json_object' verifies all expected boolean values (Marvel, Toys, Kids, Price High-Low = true, is_other_exist = false) which correctly validates task completion.

Minor consideration: Relies on specific Kohl's website structure (pmpSearch_breadcrumb, sbSelector classes). If website structure changes, evaluation may fail, but this is acceptable for website-specific tasks.
